historical_data_status: all original experiments and their historical holdouts are now development data

changes.recent_train: limit parameter selection to trailing 252 completed training sessions
changes.low_turnover: recent_train + rebalance every 5 common sessions + 2% NAV no-trade band; risk exits remain daily
changes.trend_guard: low_turnover + no equity exposure when previous benchmark close is at/below trailing 60-session SMA
changes.risk_scaled: trend_guard + downward-only exposure scaling to 8% annualized portfolio volatility, estimated over 20 prior common daily returns

unchanged.acceptance: OOS net return positive; holdout excess positive; close NAV max drawdown >= -8%; >=2 folds; source coverage intact

diagnostic_ablation: fixed-path transaction-cost addback only, never a gate or zero-cost causal replay
selection_for_forward: highest minimum development OOS excess across both fixed baskets among candidates with lower fixed-path cost in both and no earlier risk pause in either; tie-break declared profile order. This only nominates a research candidate, never grants promotion.
if_no_eligible_candidate: freeze no challenger; report failure without adding variants or changing thresholds

new_validation.protocol: freeze chosen profile, per-basket training-selected parameters, symbols, costs, risk rules and source hashes before collecting future sessions
new_validation.baseline: same per-basket frozen baseline parameters and same execution costs/risk rules
new_validation.completion: evaluate once after 152 new completed common sessions; no interim tuning or risk-pause reset
new_validation.additional_strength_checks: both baskets pass unchanged future OOS/holdout/drawdown gates AND challenger net return over paired baseline >0 in both; >=10 sell fills per basket; paired 5-session moving-block bootstrap 95% mean-return interval lower bound >0
new_validation.failure_policy: insufficient fills, missing data, price revisions, code changes or confidence failure => not validated; no real money or automatic promotion
new_validation.parameter_freeze: each profile selects its own parameter using only training data ending at the sealed historical cutoff; legacy expanding training versus challenger trailing252; freeze all 6 trials

excluded_claims: backtesting the six news-driven AI accounts
